verdict.rationale: Scheduling an email and undoing a send are applicable to an email client, but the evidence pack does not document either. The Graph docs cover immediate send, drafts, and sendMail options such as saving to Sent Items, with no mention of deferred delivery or an undo-send grace window. The community items concern link handling, performance, and ads, so they are irrelevant here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
